question: Which type of malware is a program or piece of code that is loaded onto a person’s computer without his knowledge and runs against his wishes?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Computer virus**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **A computer virus is a program or piece of code that gets loaded onto your computer without your knowledge and runs against your will**__.

 
 
• A computer virus is a type of program that, with or without your permission, is installed on your personal computer to collect information about users, their computers or browsing habits, which you can do without your knowledge. Tracks it and sends it to the remote user.&
